title: ICON 1.5 — Creating and Levelling Up
description: The Character Setup Wizard and the Level Up window, step by step. Opened from the tour they are previews: nothing is saved.

steps.title: Building a character
steps.content: Two windows do the paperwork for you: the Character Setup Wizard for a new character and Level Up when you reach 15 XP. This tour opens both on your character as a preview: you can look and click around, but nothing is saved, even if you press Finalize or Confirm.

steps.title: Where the wizard is
steps.content: A new character (Create Actor → Player Character) shows a Character Setup Wizard button in the header until it has a job. The wand next to the XP reopens it while the character has no bond.

steps.title: Kin and culture
steps.content: The wizard is one long page: the list on the side jumps to each step. First your kin and culture, which are for the story.

steps.title: Bond and primary action
steps.content: Your Bond is who you are outside the fight. It gives +2 to one of its primary actions (you pick which, in the next step), your Effort, and the gear kits you can carry.

steps.title: Extra dots
steps.content: Four more dots to spread over your narrative actions; at level 0 no action can go above 3. The counter tells you how many are left.

steps.title: Bond power and gear
steps.content: One power from your bond, and a look at the gear kits that come with it (the sheet keeps them on the Narrative tab).

steps.title: Starting job
steps.content: Your job sets your class, your stats, your traits and your Limit Break. The class decides which class tour is yours (Settings → Tours).

steps.title: Starting abilities
steps.content: Exactly two chapter 1 abilities of your job. Finalize at the bottom writes everything on the sheet in one go (from this tour it saves nothing).

steps.title: XP and Level Up
steps.content: Track XP with the pips or − / +. At 15 XP the Level Up button opens the level-up window; the Combat tab also shows Level Up Now. Levels 1 to 4 are chapter 1, 5 to 8 chapter 2, 9 to 12 chapter 3: the sheet sets the chapter for you.

steps.title: What the new level gives
steps.content: The first page lists what you gain at the new level: ability points, a mastery point, the Limit Break, a relic (levels 2, 6 and 9), bond powers, action improvements. At levels 4 and 8 you choose: a new job (its abilities open up to you) or one more mastery, and a bond power or +1 to two actions. Next goes to your picks.

steps.title: Your picks
steps.content: The second page asks only for what this level gives: new abilities and talents (1 AP each), a mastery, a relic, a bond power, which actions to improve. Action improvements and bond powers must be picked now or they are lost. Confirm applies everything and resets your XP (from this tour it saves nothing).

steps.title: Changing your mind
steps.content: On the Notes tab, Refocus rebuilds a character (p.113): keep your jobs and pick abilities again (4 Dust), reset the jobs too (8 Dust), or start over for free. It asks before doing anything. Next to it, the character management box warns you if you spent more AP or masteries than your levels give.

steps.title: Done
steps.content: The previews close now. The Character Sheet tour shows the rest of the sheet, and at the end suggests the tour of your class.
